api.view_key_value_documents: Reads sessions, messages, settings, feedback and the other Custom Objects that hold the assistant's state, and reads the composed pages
api.manage_key_value_documents: Creates, updates and deletes those Custom Objects (chat history, settings, encrypted identity tokens, feedback, composed pages)

oauth.view_key_value_documents: Reads the composed pages stored as Custom Objects; in the Custom View the list only has to be non-empty
oauth.manage_key_value_documents: Lets the chat application save and delete composed pages; in the Custom View the list only has to be non-empty
oauth.view_mcp_servers: Lists Managed MCP servers with the signed-in user's own permissions (administrator setup screen of the chat application; the Custom View declares it for parity and does not use it)
oauth.manage_mcp_servers: Creates Managed MCP servers with the signed-in user's own permissions (administrator setup screen of the chat application; the Custom View declares it for parity and does not use it)

oauthDefault: Commerce data that generated pages read (view) or change (manage) with the signed-in user's own token
